verdict.rationale: Unleash documents variants for A/B and multivariate testing, and its homepage mentions experimentation. Its impact metrics only gate rollouts on thresholds. Nothing in the evidence documents a Bayesian or frequentist statistics engine or variance-reduction options behind experiment results. Variant assignment is an adjacent building block, not the analysis capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can trust a documented statistics engine (Bayesian or frequentist, with variance-reduction options) behind experiment results
